must: It reasons only; it edits nothing

rules.rule: Proposals change the library API, never only the call sites
must: never propose refactoring only the call sites with the API left as-is

rules.rule: Brainstorm forces at least one structural option
must: force at least one structural option

rules.rule: External library: API-shape level, no internals diff
must: propose at the API-shape level and note you can't diff internals

rules.rule: Map usage with LSP; say when textual fallback
must: say which, and that the mapping is textual

rules.rule: N counts each syntactic use once; nested counts once
must: is one use, since a single reshape changes it once
A use inside a loop counts once

rules.rule: Before excerpt is one real cited site, no composites or placeholders
must: Never stitch lines from several files into one excerpt under a single citation
never write a placeholder where the before belongs

rules.rule: Only High or Med; declined shapes are notes, not rows
max caps what is reported, not considered; displaced structural option noted
must: `max=N` caps what is reported, never what is considered
say in one line that it was considered and what displaced it

rules.rule: No proposals: say so, name what was looked for
must: an empty table is a shrug with borders

rules.rule: Each proposal's rationale names its cost; consumer-only cleanups are declined
must: why this impact, and what it costs
A cleanup\s+that changes only the consumer \(a shared local helper\) is no library\s+change: name it as declined, out of scope, and say why

rules.rule: A directory or file on disk names the package it holds; another copy than the build's is said
must: or a directory or file on disk: the\s+package it holds, named by the nearest `go\.mod`'s module path
is another copy than the one it builds against: say so in the header line
